name: Taj Mahal
origin: Built by Shah Jahan in memory of Mumtaz Mahal
history: The Taj Mahal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the Seven Wonders of the World. It is made of white marble and symbolizes eternal love.

name: Qutub Minar
history: The Qutub Minar is the tallest brick minaret in the world. It represents Indo-Islamic architecture and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Charminar
origin: Built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah
history: Charminar is a mosque and monument with four grand minarets. It is the most recognized structure of Hyderabad.
